changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.template_notification ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, template_id UUID NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, sms_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, sms_text TEXT, firebase_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, firebase_text TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_integration_template_notification_tpl_event ON integration.template_notification (template_id, event) WHERE deleted = FALSE;

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO integration.template_notification (template_id, event, sms_enabled, sms_text, firebase_enabled, firebase_text, deleted, created_date, last_modified_date) SELECT d.template_id, d.event, d.sms_enabled, d.sms_text, d.firebase_enabled, d.firebase_text, d.deleted, d.created_date, d.last_modified_date FROM document.template_notification d WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM integration.template_notification i WHERE i.template_id = d.template_id AND i.event = d.event AND i.deleted = FALSE );
